reason: I cook maybe two or three times a week, so 3 free questions a day is already more than I'd ever use, and if I get stuck I just ask my mum on LINE or watch a free YouTube clip. Paying 99 baht, almost two plates of kaprao, for unlimited questions I won't use makes no sense.
objection: There are only two dishes and both are basic, kaprao and khai jiao, which I can learn free from a video or from my mum. The paid part only gives me more questions, and I'd never run out of the free ones.
would_change_my_mind: If the membership unlocked a big set of everyday dishes I actually want to cook, not just more questions, I might try one month.
